plain_description.what: Without labels, compares how two embedding models (qwen3 vs gemma) group the same texts, at increasing numbers of k-means clusters, on MASSIVE and CLINC. Scores are scaled against a near-copy of qwen3. No calls.
plain_description.why: It asks whether different embedders agree at coarse levels but disagree at fine ones, which bears on whether the tree depends on the embedder.
plain_description.information: A clear trend would show where the embedders diverge. Result: the prediction failed. Agreement rises slightly with more clusters, but the method produces the same trend under a null, so it gives no label-free support either way. That is not a refutation. It does not say which embedder is better.
